purpose: Bind the local third-party dependencies used by the preserved SIFT and ALIKED-LightGlue bridge code without committing the vendored dependency tree.

excluded_local_tree.reason_for_exclusion: The directory contains a reproducible upstream checkout, isolated Python packages, model checkpoints, and a generated Matplotlib cache. These are local runtime dependencies rather than repository source files.
excluded_local_tree.interpretation_limit: Exclusion from Git does not imply that these files are disposable. This manifest does not authorize moving or deleting them.

expected_local_layout.purpose: Isolated Kornia and OpenCV Python distributions
Exact ALIKED and LightGlue checkpoint files
Generated local Matplotlib cache; not a scientific dependency

runtime_environment_observed.interpretation: Observed local versions used for the focused preservation tests; this is an environment binding, not a claim that every version is minimal or uniquely required.

focused_test_receipt.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=third_party/python_pkgs python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_sift_bridge.py tests/test_aliked_lightglue_bridge.py
focused_test_receipt.test_scope: Focused unit tests for the preserved SIFT and ALIKED-LightGlue bridge modules only.
focused_test_receipt.scientific_interpretation: Passing these tests checks bounded software behavior. It does not establish material attachment, eliminate sliding or wobble, validate a full experimental run, or authorize promotion.

reconstruction_requirements: Clone https://github.com/cvg/LightGlue.git into third_party/LightGlue and check out commit eb42fee2d71449efb0aa5c10549752b5d75384d8.
Install Kornia 0.6.12 and opencv-python-headless 4.12.0.88 into third_party/python_pkgs, then verify the recorded METADATA and RECORD hashes.
Place the two checkpoint files at their recorded third_party/model_cache/hub/checkpoints paths and verify both size and SHA-256 before inference.
Bind NumPy, PyTorch, and Python to the observed versions or revalidate compatibility explicitly before claiming reproduction.
